scope: One actual SUN256/SUM64 joined SU/QE recovery element; 23 positive cuts and four one-edit negatives. No fulltoken, physical or adoption claim.
assertion_precedence: All r8 conditions and ordering retained. A witness is emitted only inside its original failing branch immediately before fatal. Earlier unrelated assertions remain failures; no alternate marker list.

cases.label: physical_QE_gate
cases.fatal_marker: local ACK before actual suffix and logical EMPTY
cases.invariant: Local ACK implies inactive recovery, closed suffix, QE idle and window idle; forbidden QE admission is additionally witnessed at GO.
cases.precedence: Registered-go count check follows local-ACK guard and cannot serve as the first-failure oracle.

cases.label: PC_advance

mutation.new: else if (rec_stop || rec_bad_su_ready) begin if (st == S_GO) pc <= pc + 1'b1; st <= S_COLL_HALT; end

cases.invariant: After checking is armed, PC equals the PC sampled at injection.
cases.precedence: Admission-freeze guard precedes PC check; admission violations are unrelated failures.

cases.label: VM_frozen_store_drop

mutation.old: if(1) begin // VM_SINK_COMMIT: accepted raw stores continue during freeze
mutation.new: if(!core_rec_frozen_out) begin // MUTANT drops accepted frozen stores

cases.invariant: One accepted QE suffix drains 16 terminals and 16 raw stores into all 512 distinct sink words.
cases.precedence: ACK and raw suffix checks precede sink completeness; later frozen-frame/image checks cannot qualify.

cases.label: scalar_suppression
cases.invariant: An accepted SU while scalar suppression is asserted and SU is nonidle has no visible scalar KV writes.
cases.precedence: Admission and PC checks precede suppression; missing suppression coverage is a later distinct failure.
